description: This file defines the HomePageDao class, which extends the BaseDao class, and provides data access methods for retrieving HomePage and ModuleDefaultPage entities based on user role IDs and module names, with results ordered by priority and ID.

classes.name: HomePageDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for HomePage and ModuleDefaultPage entities, providing methods to retrieve these entities with ordering and filtering based on user roles and modules.

methods.name: getHomePagesInPriorityOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a list of HomePage entities for specified user role IDs, ordered by priority and ID in descending order to prioritize higher 'priority' and newer entries.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ModuleDefaultPage entities for a specific module and user role IDs, ordered by module name and priority in descending order.
